note: Lines 1-9 continue the Elementary list (kindergarten, trainable special class): passios. Health Services (l10): school physician is district-wide; school nurse '(Elementary School)'=passios; asst nurse '(Middle School)'=middle; asst nurse '(Senior High School)'=high; Faulkner part-time clerk-typist has no building printed=unknown. Custodial Services (l27+) is TWO columns interleaved by Textract: left = Supervisor/Foreman (Lemieux, Office Brooks House = central-office) then SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL (Paton l36, Letarte l39); right column names (Mayo l28, Sillanpoa l31, Doiron l34, Welton l38) have no heading of their own and are placed under Senior High School by column position - MODERATELY UNCERTAIN. Lines 29, 32, 35, 37, 40 etc. are tenure/replacement fragments. Honorifics dropped. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
